intro:
A mystery in a rainy manor
Read the clues and observe
Find the hidden truth
description:
On a stormy night, guests gather at an old manor.
Use the text and illustrations as clues to uncover the mystery behind a missing invitation.

The rules are simple.
Read each question, observe the people and objects on the screen, and choose the answer that seems most suspicious.
Each correct choice brings you one step closer to the truth.

Explore atmospheric scenes such as the entrance hall, guest rooms, and portrait gallery, each with its own mystery to solve.

No complicated controls are needed, making it easy to enjoy for mystery fans and first-time puzzle players alike.
When you get stuck, hints help you keep going and think through each case at your own pace.

Recommended for players who enjoy:
・Short mystery puzzles
・Reading text and finding clues in illustrations
・Observation, deduction, and brain-training games
・Playing solo or discussing the answer with family and friends
・Classic manor mysteries with invitations, servants, secrets, and suspicious guests

Listen to the rain, examine every clue, and reveal the truth hidden inside the manor.
